title: Tokenizer not optional
body: The CMake option `FF_BUILD_TOKENIZER` enables or disables the tokenizers-cpp subproject, but if disabled flexflow can't build, due to tokenizers being used in core flexflow. This also appears to imply that rust is no longer optional to build flexflow.  Not sure if there's a reasonable way to `#ifdef` out the tokenizer code for projects that don't need it, or if the conditional code in cmake should be made unconditional, but I think it's worth addressing.
author: stelleg

comments.body: @stelleg I can push a fix. Which branch are you working on?
@goliaro Great! Working on the inference branch

title: Methodology for training LLaMA 68M
body:
Hi, nice project!

Seems from the paper there is no discussion on how the 68M LLaMA SSM was trained. How was it trained?
author: cadedaniel

comments.body: Thx for your interest! The 68M LLaMA SSM is trained in a similar way as the 160M LLaMA, which is by training one epoch on Wikipedia, C4-RealNewsLike, and part of the C4-en dataset.

title: Missing Support For StarCoder Backbones
body:
Hi everyone! 

I was wondering if we could include support (including for batched inference and online inference) for starcoder backbones? 

I was hoping to use it as a backend for both starcoder7B and starcoder16B models, with a prioritization of the 7B model -- and having support for these backbones, including for batched inference and online inference, would be great! I've found that starcoder is strong for a variety of use cases, and leveraging this framework would be extremely helpful. 

Thank you so much!
author: VenkatKS

comments.body: Hi @VenkatKS , we are currently working on adding support for StarCoder.
